apple.name: Sportsphere
apple.subtitle: Where sports fans connect & compete
apple.description:
Sportsphere is the home of social sports — a single place to follow your favourite players, debate with fans, predict outcomes, and climb the global fan leaderboard.

KEY FEATURES

• PERSONALISED FEED — Posts, predictions, polls, and highlights from players, coaches, scouts, journalists, and fans you follow. Filter by For You, Trending, or Spotlight.

• LIVE SCORES & SPORTS — Browse all 20 supported sports (football, basketball, tennis, cricket, rugby, hockey, volleyball, handball, baseball, golf, boxing, MMA, athletics, swimming, cycling, skiing, table tennis, badminton, American football, futsal) with category badges, olympic tags, and format chips.

• PERFORMANCE LEADERBOARD — See who's hot right now across Overall, Form, Improvement, and Consistency dimensions. Top-3 gold, silver, and bronze rank pills with rank movement indicators.

• PLAYER PROFILES — Tap any player to see their tier, global rank, total points, form / consistency / improvement scores, percentile, recent events ledger, sports, and follow toggle.

• CREATE — Compose posts, predictions, polls, and highlights. Add hashtags. Mark breaking news. Reach fans across 22 role types.

• ACTIVITY FEED — Likes, comments, mentions, new followers, rank changes, and verification updates — all in one place with typed icons.

• VERIFIED & PRO BADGES — Trust signals for verified athletes, scouts, journalists, and pro accounts.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY

Sportsphere is built for everyone in the sports world — fans, players, coaches, teams, scouts, journalists, creators, analysts, commentators, agents, organisations, competitions, leagues, academies, venues, businesses, and more. Create your free account in 30 seconds and start climbing the leaderboard.
